problem: The difficulty of automatically publishing structured Markdown notes from Obsidian to a remote blogging platform like Typecho.
summary: A publishing tool that allows users to send Obsidian notes to a Typecho blog using XML-RPC, supporting custom frontmatter mapping and external image hosting.
